title: Underwhelming
text: My dog obviously did love the set but I was slightly underwhelmed by it. The “chews” were eaten in 30 seconds and the bags of treats are sorta small. Toys were sized as expected and my dog rips anything up if given ten minutes so they worked as expected. There was a ball in the one toy which is his favorite toy and he hasn’t put it down since. The squeaky candy corn felt like really good quality but he’s more interested in the ball. It seems like it should be about $10 cheaper per month though.
label: neutral
